title: 小学三年级
description: 适合8-9岁孩子，独立阅读起步、科普词汇引入、故事类短片理解力提升
descriptionEn: For children aged 8-9. Beginning independent reading, introduction to science vocabulary, improved story comprehension.

items.description: 卷毛老师带学生坐神奇校车深入人体、太空、海底，科普词汇密集，故事性强。
items.descriptionEn: Ms. Frizzle takes students on the Magic School Bus deep into the human body, space, and ocean floor. Dense science vocabulary, strong storytelling.

items.description: Kratts兄弟用 Creature Power 变身动物探索自然，动物科普+动作冒险，男孩女孩都爱看。
items.descriptionEn: The Kratt brothers use Creature Power to transform into animals and explore nature. Animal science plus action adventure, loved by all.

items.description: 拥有超能力的单词女孩一边打击犯罪一边教新词汇，每集重点讲解2-3个高级词汇。
items.descriptionEn: WordGirl fights crime while teaching new vocabulary. Each episode highlights 2-3 advanced words in context.

items.description: 八个小探险家海底探险，海洋生物知识+团队合作，角色配音英音标准。
items.descriptionEn: Eight explorers on underwater adventures. Marine biology knowledge plus teamwork. Standard British accent voice acting.

items.description: 莱德和六只小狗的救援任务，团队合作+解决问题，指令句型和职业词汇丰富。
items.descriptionEn: Ryder and six puppies on rescue missions. Teamwork plus problem solving. Rich in command sentences and occupation vocabulary.

items.description: 好奇猴乔治的搞笑冒险，旁白讲述清晰，因果逻辑句型和科普词汇自然融入。
items.descriptionEn: Funny adventures of Curious George. Clear narration, cause-effect logic sentences and science vocabulary naturally integrated.

items.description: 真人主持人穿越恐龙时代与自然世界，科普词汇密集，孩子看得目不转睛。
items.descriptionEn: Live host travels through dinosaur age and natural world. Dense science vocabulary, children watch with fixed eyes.

items.description: Steve Backshall寻找全球最致命的动物，野生动物纪录片风格，高阶科普英语。
items.descriptionEn: Steve Backshall hunts for the world's deadliest animals. Wildlife documentary style, advanced science English.

items.description: 双胞胎医生兄弟用实验和医院实拍讲解人体知识，医学词汇丰富但讲解有趣不吓人。
items.descriptionEn: Twin doctor brothers explain human body knowledge through experiments and hospital footage. Rich medical vocabulary, fun and not scary.
